findings.architecture_type: Dual-Layer Hybrid: Client-Side MPA Physics Visualization Engine + Python FastAPI Headless Microservices

frontend_stack.paradigm: Multi-Page Application (MPA) with self-contained vanilla ES6 JavaScript modules
frontend_stack.rendering: HTML5 2D Canvas Context + Three.js r128 (WebGL) for instrument 3D chassis visualization
frontend_stack.state_management: Vanilla DOM-bound state objects per simulator page; local web storage for settings

hplc_simulator_script.js.role: Full chromatographic kinetic engine, LSS gradient integration, Darcy pressure, EMG peak synthesis

gc_script.js.role: Capillary gas chromatography, Golay HETP, temperature programming, Kovats indices

ftir_script.js.role: FTIR spectrum generator, functional group mapping, interactive ATR assembly

ftir_enhancements.js.role: Advanced FTIR spectrum comparison, baseline correction, spectral subtraction

polarimeter_script.js.role: Biot law optical rotation, Drude wavelength dispersion, half-shade visualizer

uv_vis_script.js.role: Beer-Lambert spectrophotometry, Gaussian absorption bands, calibration curves

mass_spec_script.js.role: Nominal mass stick spectrum, isotopic distribution, common loss fragmentation

psa_script.js.role: Log-normal particle size distribution, D-value interpolation, Sauter mean D[3,2]

assistant.js.role: Pedagogical conversational UI, tool-call orchestration, dynamic chart rendering

virtual_lab.js.role: Unified laboratory shell, benchtop state, safety checklist, procedural tracking

backend_stack.database: SQLite (test_simupharma.db) with SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM; Alembic migration scaffold present
backend_stack.science_package: backend/science/ (7 standalone mathematical modules: hplc.py, gc.py, ftir.py, uvvis.py, mass_spec.py, polarimeter.py, psa.py)
backend_stack.ai_proxy: backend/ai/router.py (Universal LLM gateway supporting Groq Llama-3.1, Gemini Flash, OpenRouter, OpenAI)

reproducibility_evaluation.code_modularity: High in backend science package; moderate in frontend due to monolithic script architecture
reproducibility_evaluation.determinism: Physics equations are deterministic; noise injection uses pseudorandom normal generators without explicit seeds
reproducibility_evaluation.environment_coupling: Backend requires Python 3.10+ with numpy, scipy, pydantic, fastapi; frontend runs in standard ECMAScript 2020 browser
reproducibility_evaluation.test_suite: 90 automated tests in tests/ (smoke and route integration tests; 0 scientific accuracy validation tests)
